_about: Shelter website access decisions, including own websites found behind VMVT Facebook entries. Registry transcription: docs/discovery-engine/vmvt-guardian-inventory.tsv. Public visibility and robots access do not establish a republication licence. decision adapter = tested collector; blocked = explicit robots/terms restriction; no_listing = no verifiable individual adoption list; adoption_confirmation_required = current list includes found animals without explicit availability; other_thread = separate work; paused = intentionally unavailable; unreachable = access failed. Alternative-channel review: docs/scrapers/alternative-channel-review-2026-11-19.json. No login or access-control bypass. Owner decision 2026-11-19 permits reading genuinely public Facebook animal posts without login; this does not grant access to restricted content or create a republication licence.
